It's true.
In our lifes, may be, couldn't be without electricity.
Some people can live without this, but I am sure that the world would be very different.
When we are using different equipments in our houses, we are using the electricity.
Small things but very importants in our lifes.
For example: T.V., computer, just light and a long list that now I can not write.
I don't like tinking , my house of my life, without all this facilities.
In winter when is dark very early, and after, I need to spent my free time in home.
What I can do without my music and my computer.
Now, just you need to think that you would do or what would happen in a city, with a car, aeroplans, shoops, all these things without lights.
Finally.
I think that everybody know that the electricity is very important invent and for me it is the best.
